'''Sergeant Jojames''' was a [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a member of the [[Balmorran resistance]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
Stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], he discovered that the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] planned on retaking the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]] and complete an unfinished access corridor that leads to the back of the factory. Jojames was able to obtain enough explosive ordnance to destroy the drill digging the corridor and send a Republic spacer to clear a path for his men.
